title: Anuki Premachandra: Planting the Seeds for Understanding
summary: Divya talks with Sri Lankan founder Anuki Premachandra about leaving a decade in the development sector to start Lines, a digital strategy agency in Colombo. They get into being underestimated as a young woman in NGO rooms, what behavior-change communications taught her, her advocacy campaign that pushed the import tax on sanitary pads down from 101 percent in Sri Lanka, and why so much creative work today defaults to a Silicon Valley aesthetic.
